summary.prose: Building this Story means writing the conversion engine first and exercising it on legacy fixtures, then moving the rest of the code off the old approval, review, feedback and tracker fields in ordered groups: readers first, then writers and gates, then the feedback and tracker fallbacks, then the entry-point guards. The conversion is run on this repository by hand after the BUILD is approved. Each task names the files and tests it may change, so the work lands in small steps that keep the typecheck and its own tests green.

Update src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/feedback-convert.test.ts and add src/workflow/convert/__tests__/convert-feedback.test.ts.
